assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential rhythm disturbances.
The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT code 93229.
The diagnosis code I49.9 supports the cardiac condition underlying this order.
The diagnosis code Z86.73 supports the relevant history underlying this order.
